schedulers.name: isolate-experiment
schedulers.description: Puts all VMs on one host that has no VMs: the host that you set for the first VM if that host is empty, else the empty host with the most free memory. Replaces the hosts that you set.

schedulers.name: round-robin
schedulers.description: Puts each VM that has no host on the host that has the fewest VMs at that time, so that the VMs spread evenly. Keeps the hosts that you set.

schedulers.name: subnet-compute
schedulers.description: Puts VMs whose first interface is on the same VLAN on the same host while it has free memory, and starts each new VLAN on the host with the least committed memory. Keeps the hosts that you set.
